_readme: Hand-maintained, not auto-generated. Edit this file directly and push —
there is no in-app editor for it, matching every other repo-level config
in this project (waterways.json, forecast-config.json, etc.).
topForecasters: pick 4 ids from app.js's REAL_SOURCES list (metoffice,
ecmwf, gfs, icon, gem, meteofrance, jma, bom, cma). This can't be
computed automatically — the actual per-source accuracy data (FFV)
only exists in each phone's own localStorage after running Settings ->
Compare's 'Backfill 1 year of real data', never in this repo. Check
Compare's accuracy table on your own phone occasionally and update this
list by hand if the ranking has genuinely shifted — see the session
note on this: 'not a permanent list... would want an occasional
re-check, not a big burden, just not zero'.
weatherLocations: your saved front-page places. Precached with the 4
topForecasters above, hourly-equivalent data, on the schedule set in
the workflow file (.github/workflows/precache-weather.yml).
fishingSpots: your saved tide/fishing marks. Precached with ONE
unmodelled (default blended) source, matching what fishing.js's own
live fetch already requests — refreshed 4x/day (roughly every 6
hours), tracked via a UTC time-bucket in the output file so a late or
early-firing run still only refreshes once per bucket, not twice.
markType 'coastal' also fetches the marine API (wave height etc) —
genuinely a second request for that spot, not folded into the 'one
source' count. See fishing.js's own fetchFishingForecast for why.
weatherFavourites / fishingFavourites: NOT hand-maintained — these are
written automatically by the favourite-relay Cloudflare Worker (see
favourite-relay-worker.js) when someone taps the ★ button next to a
saved place in Settings. Each entry is only a postcode OUTWARD code
(e.g. 'TA6') — deliberately never a resolved place name or exact
coordinates, so a favourite never puts anyone's precise location in
this public repo. precache-weather.mjs geocodes the outcode to a
centroid (via postcodes.io, same source the app itself already
trusts) at fetch time, same as it always has for the hand-typed
entries above. Capped at 8 entries per list by the Worker itself —
once full it rejects new favourites rather than evicting an existing
one; delete an entry here by hand (or ask whoever added it to remove
their locally-saved place — that does NOT auto-remove it from here,
favourites are sticky by design) to free up a slot. You can also
still hand-edit these two arrays directly, same as the others — the
Worker only ever appends, it never assumes it's the sole writer.
Sizing formula (for updating the workflow's cron interval by hand
after editing this file — GitHub Actions cron is static YAML, this
script can't adjust its own schedule):
weather/day = (weatherLocations.length + weatherFavourites.length) *
topForecasters.length * (1440 / intervalMinutes)
fishing/day = (fishingSpots.length + fishingFavourites.length) *
(2 if any coastal else 1) * 4
total/day should stay comfortably under 9000 (see the session's own
margin discussion) to leave headroom for GitHub's own scheduling
drift meaning some days run a few extra times. At the current caps
(8 + 8 favourites, worst case all coastal) this adds at most
8*4*72 = 2304 weather requests/day and 8*2*4 = 64 fishing
requests/day beyond the hand-maintained entries — check this still
clears 9000 with room to spare before raising either cap.
